# Golden State Glam

> Personalized facials and skincare studio in Fair Oaks, California. Booking stays on GlossGenius. This file describes only what the website publishes.

Facials in Fair Oaks, CA, by licensed esthetician Veronika Reil. Golden State Glam offers facials from $90 to $180 at one studio. Book online.

## Choose by goal

### First visit
New here? Start with the New Client Signature Facial. It is $150 and 80 minutes.

### Glow and hydration
Korean Glass Skin is the hydration facial: serum, a hydrating mask, and facial massage.
  - Korean Glass Skin Facial: $165 / 75 min. https://goldenstateglam.com/services/korean-glass-skin/

### Deep cleanse
A full cleanse when extractions may be part of the visit. They happen only when they suit your skin that day.
  - Signature Deep Cleanse Facial: $180 / 90 min. https://goldenstateglam.com/services/signature-deep-cleanse/

### Acne-prone and teen skin
A gentle facial for teen skin, with cleansing and lightweight hydration. Contact me about age and guardian requirements before booking.
  - Teen Skin Clear Facial: $90 / 50 min. https://goldenstateglam.com/services/teen-skin-clear/

### Men
A facial written for men’s skincare goals, including skin that feels sensitive from shaving. Other facials on the menu are not limited to one kind of client.
  - Men’s Deep Clean Facial: $180 / 90 min. https://goldenstateglam.com/services/mens-deep-clean/

### Relaxation
Choose a massage-focused visit, from Lymphatic Drainage Facial Massage to the Deep Relax & Sleep Ritual. Ask me about the current price and appointment length for Gua Sha.

## Korean Glass Skin Facial
https://goldenstateglam.com/services/korean-glass-skin/

### How much is the Korean Glass Skin Facial, and how long is it?
The published price is $165 and the visit is 75 minutes. Confirm the price and length on the booking screen. This page does not list a deposit for this facial.

### Will my skin look like glass afterward?
The name describes a dewy look, not a guaranteed finish. The facial focuses on hydration, with serum infusion and a hydrating mask with facial massage. How your skin looks afterward varies.

### Does this facial include extractions?
Extractions are not on the published step list for Korean Glass Skin. If cleansing and extractions are the goal, read the Signature Deep Cleanse Facial, which is $180 and 90 minutes.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Golden State Glam?
You’ll find my studio at 7996 California Ave, Suite A, Fair Oaks, CA 95628. All appointments take place at this Fair Oaks location. Clients come from Fair Oaks, Folsom, El Dorado Hills, Carmichael, and Sacramento.

### How do I book a facial?
Choose a service from the menu, then use Book now. It opens the studio’s booking site, where you continue on to choose a time. You can also call or text (916) 304-3810. If you are unsure which service to choose, call, text, or send a message before you book.

### What does a facial cost?
The New Client Signature Facial is $150. The Signature Deep Cleanse Facial is $180. The Teen Skin Clear Facial is $90. The Korean Glass Skin Facial is $165. Prices and appointment lengths vary by service. Check the current menu, and the booking screen, before you reserve.

### Which facial should I choose for my first visit?
New here? Start with the New Client Signature Facial. It is $150 and 80 minutes: a short consultation, a close look at your skin, then a full facial built around what your skin needs that day. If you already know you want a cleanse, hydration, or massage, read that service next. Suitability still depends on your skin.

### How long will my appointment take?
Appointment lengths vary. The New Client Signature Facial is 80 minutes. The Signature Deep Cleanse Facial is 90 minutes. The Teen Skin Clear Facial is 50 minutes. The Korean Glass Skin Facial is 75 minutes. Facial massage visits range from 70 minutes to 90 minutes. Check your selected service and your confirmation for the scheduled length.

### Do you offer facials for men and teens?
Yes. The menu includes a Men’s Deep Clean Facial and a Teen Skin Clear Facial. Contact the studio about teen booking and guardian requirements before making an appointment.

### Is a deposit required?
Some services require a deposit. The Signature Deep Cleanse Facial lists a $50 deposit for new clients. The Lymphatic Drainage Facial Massage lists a $50 deposit. The Deep Relax & Sleep Ritual lists an $80 deposit for new clients. Any requirement shown on the booking screen is the one to follow. Review those terms before you confirm.

### What is your cancellation policy?
The studio’s published policy includes a 50% cancellation fee. If you need to change your visit, say so as soon as you can, and review the booking terms before you reserve.

### What should I share before a facial?
Tell me about sensitivities, allergies, recent procedures and the skincare products you use so we can discuss suitability and preparation. Facials and massage here are cosmetic and relaxation services, not medical treatments. Results vary. For a medical skin concern, consult a qualified healthcare professional.

### What are your business hours?
Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday, 10 AM–6 PM. Closed Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday. An open day does not mean every hour is free. Check online booking for current appointment times.
